Each version needs its own directory under root/<name>/<version>/. Store the artifact as model.pkl (pickle.dump) and the metadata as metadata.json (json.dumps). Check if the version dir already exists in register() and raise ValueError if it does.

promote() needs to persist the alias → version mapping so a fresh ModelRegistry instance can resolve it. A simple approach: write root/<name>/aliases.json as {"production": "2", ...}. load() reads that file first, resolves the alias to a version string, then loads the corresponding model.pkl.

list_versions() iterates sorted(Path(root/name).iterdir()), skips non-directories, reads each version's metadata.json, and returns [{"version": dir.name, "metadata": {...}}, ...]. The test creates a fresh ModelRegistry(same_dir) after registering — all state must come from disk, not instance variables.
